explication: DreamCraft3D turns a reference image and text prompt into a coherent textured 3D object through coarse geometry, geometry refinement, and texture refinement. The documented workflow preprocesses the image, trains successive scene representations with view-dependent diffusion guidance, then exports a mesh. The README also describes optional personalized diffusion training from generated multi-view images. Source excerpts establish key system, dataset, geometry, renderer, and guidance components; some subsystem links below reflect documented workflow rather than inspected call sites.
